card.name: Partway through all-caps medical words
card.fires_on: Mid-word pieces of long words in ALL-CAPS label text, such as PEN-IC-ILLINS, PAT-IENT and ANTI-INFLAMMAT-ORY. Also fires on an opening quote mark before a quoted word.

modes.label: All-caps word pieces
modes.description: A middle piece of a long capitalised drug or medical word, where the rest of the word follows.
modes.example: PATIENT HAS HAD PREVIOUS HYPERSENSITIVITY REACTIONS TO CEFTAZIDIME, CEPHALOSPORINS, PEN<<IC>>ILLINS, OR OTHER DRUGS

modes.label: Opening quote
modes.description: A quotation mark opening a quoted term in plain web text.
